findings.description: A delayed watchdog could permit late completion. Final code computes an entry-time absolute monotonic deadline, checks admission/receive paths, and rechecks under the terminal-result lock before accepting success.
findings.evidence: Deterministic held-watchdog test passes final source; isolated removal of final success guard exits 1 as expected.
